job_spec.purpose: qfd_row_merge_native_fence (7eea9e354, branch claude/sys-takeover-rowmerge-20261009): ot_qfd_row_merge_fence binds the 32 per-PC head owners to the row crossbar with the kv-die KV4 write-then-read fence per PC (CONTRACT v1.1), grant->{pc,mask} ACK lanes; rev3: bare pin flops on every input; grant group pre-encode and write-ack decode registered behind them; +3 edges on a PC's grant->next-head turnaround, +2 on a fence release. ~340 pins, small logic: outline is pin-bound, not util-bound. Variant a: 60x60, HM 0.025, PD 0.55.
